amendments: A1: the final runner composes the A1 baseline exactly once (A1_REQUIRED_CASES), the 12 frozen A2M ids exactly once through runMatrixCases, and four owned ids: concurrent-first-sockets, coop-mission-provisioned, coop-restart-action-accepted, coop-first-rolls-captured. A2_REQUIRED_CASES is that ordered list of 26 ids and is what B imports.

A2 (setup fix, Root ruling 2026-10-26): concurrent-first-sockets uses two participant sockets (host and guest) whose first upgrades and joins are in flight at once on a fresh lobby match, then the lobby launch, one accepted AdvancePhase whose event id the host reply and the guest delivery must both carry, no Error frame on either socket, and a stored journal with eventCount === maxSequence + 1. It makes no spectate call (the route accepts spectators only on an active match) and claims no concurrent spectator.

A3 (co-op journey): coop-mission-provisioned is a real mission created through ordinary authenticated APIs (campaign PUT, co-op session, three campaign-channel joins, two CampaignParticipation messages, campaign head, mission POST with unitBootstrap and contributions) plus one accepted pre-restart action. coop-restart-action-accepted stops the owned server, reads the active unit and its owner from the product activation order with the read-only witness, restarts the same image on the same private DB, reconnects all three identities and requires the owner to get an accepted Event movement_declared for a real Move. coop-first-rolls-captured requires the first dice event after the restart to carry nonempty d6 rolls, the live and replayed rolls to match, and the stored event to carry the same rolls and intent id.

A4 (MISSION-MATCH-1): teammates on a side see each other's sealed declarations live, so the owner of the active unit is accepted whichever side entry it holds; the row asserts the accepted command and the movement_declared event, not any teammate-exclusion.
A5 (GM): the real mission GM keeps the player viewer role (known issue). The coop-gm identity is a harness label; A2 adds no GM assertion, fix or inference. S5-02 and OQ-M1 add no row.
A6 (pre-RED reachability gate): G-A1 below must pass before the RED commit; a refusal repaired inside the four owned leaves is allowed, a product seam or predecessor edit stops the unit.
A7 (unrun obligations): nothing in this admission is a built-image PASS; every owned row, the 12 inherited rows through A2 and the mutants are owed at RED/GREEN on the exact-main image.

firstRun.cause: Not the real-mission-GM AdvancePhase case: the GM issued the pre-restart AdvancePhase (an Event) so coop-mission-provisioned passed. After the restart the draft cases leaf reconnected only the three match sockets; it had closed the campaign-sync sockets before the restart. A rebuilt campaign session is paused until the GM campaign-sync connection returns (CampaignHostRegistry.ts:394 pauseUntilGmReturns; bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:1231 noteGmConnected), so the post-restart Move was refused with MATCH_PAUSED (waiting for a peer to reconnect).

probe.fix: cases leaf: provisionCoop returns reopenGm (a host CampaignJoin on the campaign channel, waiting for CampaignSnapshot); coopRestart calls it right after ctx.restart() and before connectAll and the first Move (+9 lines; oxfmt clean). Test leaf: a source-order test (restart, then reopenGm, then the Move). No product, predecessor or fifth-leaf edit.
probe.gmAdvancePhase: The real mission GM (a player-role viewer, GM role known issue unchanged) issued the pre-restart AdvancePhase and the roll-loop AdvancePhase calls and they were accepted Events, so the contributor switch (Root ruling Q6) was not needed.
probe.limits: The probe proves the setup half of the four owned rows on the ordinary APIs only (concurrent first sockets with a shared event, co-op provisioning, restart, the owner-of-the-active-unit Move and the first captured rolls with matching live and replayed rolls). It is not the registered built-image PASS of the runner: RED, GREEN, the 26-case run and the A2 mutants are owed at the implementation PR.
